findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_signup_status, save_audit_to_project, read_conversion_plan, propose_conversion_plan, setup_tracking, setup_status, verify_install · Private data: start_signup, get_signup_status, save_capi_token, get_setup_progress, get_sdk_installation, approve_conversion_plan, approve_and_start_conversion_plan, propose_conversion_plan, begin_audit, read_audit, record_audit_context, record_audit_runtime, setup_status, read_docs · Public sink: save_capi_token, get_sdk_installation, read_conversion_installation, stage_conversion_installation, record_audit_runtime, submit_findings · Destructive: delete_connected_project, record_audit_runtime.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_signup_status, save_audit_to_project, read_conversion_plan, propose_conversion_plan, setup_tracking, setup_status, verify_install · Private data: start_signup, get_signup_status, save_capi_token, get_setup_progress, get_sdk_installation, approve_conversion_plan, approve_and_start_conversion_plan, propose_conversion_plan, begin_audit, read_audit, record_audit_context, record_audit_runtime, setup_status, read_docs · Public sink: save_capi_token, get_sdk_installation, read_conversion_installation, stage_conversion_installation, record_audit_runtime, submit_findings · Destructive: delete_connected_project, record_audit_runtime

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
